CFB:cfb.ol.limiting_source_or_reason: OL starters/snaps/pressures are PFF-paid; CFBD gives only returning production and sacks
CFB:cfb.ol.notes: ESPN box scores list no OL snaps; sack-allowed proxy is not line quality or continuity. No free starter-level OL data.

CFB:cfb.in_game_exit_risk.limiting_source_or_reason: No free structured in-game injury-exit flag; CFBD plays lack injury tags, snaps paid
CFB:cfb.in_game_exit_risk.notes: Would need text-mining ESPN pbp 'injured' notes; unreliable, no snap counts to define removal of starter. Partial proxy only.

CFB:cfb.defender_production_profile.limiting_source_or_reason: Pass-rush snaps/pressures PFF-paid; CFBD has sacks/TFL/hurries only
CFB:cfb.defender_production_profile.notes: Production counts free via CFBD (key); usage/pass-rush snap denominators have no free source.

NBA:nba.def_scheme.limiting_source_or_reason: Coverage-scheme labels are not public; free stats.nba.com synergy gives only play-type frequency/PPP
NBA:nba.def_scheme.notes: Play-type half is free (stats.nba.com, history to 2015) but drop/switch/blitz not published; could be crudely inferred, not measured.

NBA:nba.reb_chances.limiting_source_or_reason: stats.nba.com tracking endpoints (free, undocumented); host denied from runner
NBA:nba.reb_chances.notes: Not in ledger (ESPN pbp has rebounds only, no chances/contested). Must be pulled; per-game vs season aggregates matter.

NBA:nba.tracking.limiting_source_or_reason: stats.nba.com (free); not in any ledger; runner probes denied
NBA:nba.tracking.notes: Tracking from 2013-14; defender distance via shot dashboards. Pull and encode needed.

needs: team defense shot dashboard by closest-defender distance
NBA:nba.opp_three_openness_allowed.notes: Season/last-N aggregates available pregame; game-level history requires per-game pulls. ESPN shot_events lack defender distance.

NBA:nba.joint_pace_interaction.limiting_source_or_reason: nba_espn_team_games 8636 rows 2023-2026 with possessions; pbp 2024-26 for transition proxy
NBA:nba.joint_pace_interaction.notes: Pace from both teams computable now with 3 seasons; transition vs half-court share derived from pbp (2 seasons), not Synergy.

CBB:cbb.lineup_adj_rating.limiting_source_or_reason: Barttorvik/EvanMiya free; availability must be captured prospectively (ESPN injuries snapshot-only)
CBB:cbb.lineup_adj_rating.notes: Player ratings backfillable, but tonight's active set has no history; vintaged availability required.

CBB:cbb.defense_style.limiting_source_or_reason: Possession-type tagging is Synergy/Hudl-paid; Barttorvik has only tempo/TO% proxies
CBB:cbb.defense_style.notes: TO% and steal rate free, but zone/press/pack-line classification has no public source.

CBB:cbb.fouls_officials.limiting_source_or_reason: ESPN summaries/NCAA box scores; officials via ESPN gameInfo where present
CBB:cbb.fouls_officials.notes: Fouls/FTA in ESPN box scores; crew assignment completeness unverified (cbb summary probe 404 at tested path). Crew known pregame only close to tip.

CBB:cbb.teammate_absence_shift.notes: Ledger holds game-level only, not player box. Absences inferable from minutes=0; small samples per player.

CBB:cbb.handler_absence_pace_shift.limiting_source_or_reason: ESPN pbp for custom on/off (Barttorvik lineup splits unverified)
CBB:cbb.handler_absence_pace_shift.notes: Needs full pbp pull and on-floor reconstruction from sub events; pregame availability prospective.

CBB:cbb.rebound_competition_on_floor.notes: Static ratings free; on-floor scenarios need availability inputs (prospective).

CBB:cbb.ball_handler_succession_map.notes: Needs pbp pull and derived lineups; succession computed from with/without splits, thin samples.

CBB:cbb.assisted_three_dependency.notes: ESPN pbp text names assister; must be pulled and parsed. SR gives season share only.

needs: NIT/Crown selection rules and fields by season
NET and team-sheet metrics at Selection Sunday
CBB:cbb.secondary_postseason_field_model.limiting_source_or_reason: NCAA.com announcements, NET public; KenPom vintages via own capture/Wayback
CBB:cbb.secondary_postseason_field_model.notes: Crown only 2025-26 (n tiny); NIT history from NCAA. KenPom archival snapshots not guaranteed; prior-year vintages partial.

needs: timestamped captures of KenPom ratings page
CBB:cbb.kenpom_snapshot_timing_rules.limiting_source_or_reason: Own capture and Internet Archive; KenPom host denied; main table free to view
CBB:cbb.kenpom_snapshot_timing_rules.notes: Timing of Monday refresh is observable only prospectively or via sparse Wayback captures.

NHL:nhl.officials.notes: Penalties in ledger-adjacent archives; referee assignments need pulling per game. Assignments announced day-of.

SOCCER:soc.pace_press.limiting_source_or_reason: Understat PPDA (6 leagues) and ESPN possession; FBref Opta advanced removed Jan 2026
SOCCER:soc.pace_press.notes: football-data lacks these; Understat/ESPN pull needed. Coverage limited to big-5 + RPL via Understat.

SOCCER:soc.set_pieces.limiting_source_or_reason: Aerial duel/taker data was FBref/Opta; no free source after Jan 2026; Understat gives set-piece shot situations only
SOCCER:soc.set_pieces.notes: Shots from set pieces free, but takers and aerial strength not. Partial StatsBomb open sample only.

SOCCER:soc.transfers.notes: Dated historical events; pull and encode needed. News timing needs prospective capture for new events.

SOCCER:soc.xg_adjusted_ratings.notes: Not in ledger (football-data has no xG). Rating model fully free once pulled.

SOCCER:soc.rotation_index.limiting_source_or_reason: ESPN soccer summaries/Transfermarkt lineups; openfootball fixtures
SOCCER:soc.rotation_index.notes: Lineups need scraping; target label (rotation) derived from XI changes. Press-conference hints prospective.

SOCCER:soc.added_time.limiting_source_or_reason: ESPN commentary/StatsBomb; football-data referee only for E0
SOCCER:soc.added_time.notes: Added time derived from last event minute; referee assignment free for EPL only in football-data, others need pull.

SOCCER:soc.open_game_index.notes: BTTS and clean-sheet rates computable from FTHG/FTAG; xG-based refinement would need Understat but not required.

SOCCER:soc.cup_progression_load.limiting_source_or_reason: openfootball, ESPN soccer scoreboard, UEFA pages
SOCCER:soc.cup_progression_load.notes: football-data covers leagues only; cups and Europe need pulling. Priority is hand-coded.

SOCCER:soc.leader_race_state.notes: Scorers/minutes not in football-data CSVs; pull needed. State at time t is strictly pregame-computable.

SOCCER:soc.award_voting_narrative.notes: Few observations per award; media narrative component has no systematic free dataset, only results and team success.

needs: player shots and SoT by match
SOCCER:soc.player_shot_share.limiting_source_or_reason: Understat player shots (free scrape); FBref denied/unverified
SOCCER:soc.player_shot_share.notes: Understat has shots not SoT by player; SoT share via ESPN player stats. Big-5 coverage.

SOCCER:soc.team_fail_to_score_propensity.notes: Goals are available now, but excess over expectation needs xG from Understat (not in ledger).

SOCCER:soc.shared_shock_overlap.limiting_source_or_reason: Fixture lists, Transfermarkt call-ups/injury history (free scrape)
SOCCER:soc.shared_shock_overlap.notes: Transfermarkt injury histories carry dates enabling backfill; live injury exposure is prospective.

needs: goal log with situation tag and minute
SOCCER:soc.first_goal_route_mix.notes: Open play/set piece/penalty tags in Understat; own goals via ESPN. Not in ledger.

SOCCER:soc.team_goal_share_competition.notes: Needs pull; squad changes from Transfermarkt.

SOCCER:soc.xi_attack_defence_split.notes: Player xGA on/off not published free; must be estimated via RAPM-style regression on lineups, heavy modelling.

needs: crosses and attack zones by team
SOCCER:soc.cross_and_wide_play_share.limiting_source_or_reason: Zone-level event data Opta/WhoScored; free only partially (StatsBomb open sample, ESPN team crosses counts)
SOCCER:soc.cross_and_wide_play_share.notes: ESPN box has total crosses, but share of attacks through wide areas lacks a free full-coverage source.

SOCCER:soc.first_goalscorer_race_model.notes: All inputs free; lineups and sub timing need pulling. Model inputs must exclude anytime-scorer prices.

SOCCER:soc.shot_event_definition_mapping.limiting_source_or_reason: ESPN soccer boxscore + football-data shots + Understat + provider docs
SOCCER:soc.shot_event_definition_mapping.notes: football-data shots in profiled files; second provider (ESPN/Understat) must be pulled for overlap.

SOCCER:soc.player_tournament_match_expos.notes: Few tournaments for calibration; appearances need pulling.

SOCCER:soc.shootout_length_distribution.notes: Public but needs compilation across competitions; historical sample a few hundred shootouts.

SOCCER:soc.tournament_player_scoring_poo.limiting_source_or_reason: FIFA squads, Transfermarkt, Understat (big-5 only), FotMob
SOCCER:soc.tournament_player_scoring_poo.notes: Understat misses non-big-5 clubs; FotMob free coverage wider but scrape ToS risk. Coverage gap makes this the weakest REQUIRES_COLLECTION.

needs: goal/shot events with minute and score state
SOCCER:soc.late_level_risk_appetite.notes: Goals with minutes feasible; shot events in late-level knockouts only from limited StatsBomb sample; sparse n.

SOCCER:soc.pair_onpitch_overlap_model.notes: Hist sub minutes free; pregame availability prospective.

TENNIS:ten.in_play.limiting_source_or_reason: Sackmann slam pbp (Slams only); live feed has no free historic archive
TENNIS:ten.in_play.notes: Not in ledger (ATP/WTA matches only). Non-Slam point history absent; live feed must be captured prospectively.

TENNIS:ten.double_fault_pressure.notes: Ledger matches have df/bpFaced totals, not DF on break points; need pbp pull (Slams, MCP subset).

TENNIS:ten.ball_change_cycle.notes: Schedule rule public (7/9 etc.); per-event register needs encoding; game sequences Slams only.

TENNIS:ten.exhibition_format_effort.limiting_source_or_reason: No free structured exhibition dataset; effort not measured
TENNIS:ten.exhibition_format_effort.notes: Catalog itself says exhibition results none free; Wikipedia pages sparse and non-systematic.

TENNIS:ten.game_serial_dependence.notes: Slam-only sample (not in ledger); ATP match CSV has set scores only, not game order.
